$description: Theme-independent primitives surfaced to Tailwind 4 via @theme inline: the neutral graphite ramp (for surfaces/wells and the access-graph neutrals beyond the semantic tokens), self-hosted font stacks, instrument-grade radii, and the fast/mechanical motion curves. Identical in light and dark. Re-derived to a near-neutral cool gray (brandv4 neutrals #28282b / #fafaf9) so the warm-graphite tint no longer survives in graphs/dots. Emitted into the @theme inline{} block by tokens/build.mjs (ADM-CORE-04).
